start.title: الصوت من الأعالي
start.text:
صوت يملأ السماء.
«يا نوح — ابنِ فلكًا. طوفان قادم.»

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The voice fades. But the weight in your chest remains.
[TODO:ar] Genesis 6:22 — Noah did everything just as God commanded him.
[TODO:ar] No answer comes. Only the command remains.

mockery.title: أصوات الحشد
mockery.text:
يتجمع القرويون، يضحكون.
«قارب؟ هنا؟ أنت مجنون أيها الشيخ.»

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your words only feed their mockery.
[TODO:ar] Hebrews 11:7 — By faith Noah kept building the ark, despite the world's mockery.
[TODO:ar] They turn their backs. You are alone in faith.

building.title: السرو والزفت
building.text:
سنوات من العرق. الخشب يتشقق. الزفت يسد.
ظهرك يؤلمك، لكن الفلك يرتفع.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Rest a while, the work is endless
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Doubt creeps in with the silence.
[TODO:ar] Genesis 6:14-16 — Noah built the ark of cypress wood exactly as God instructed.

ark_done.title: لقد اكتمل
ark_done.text:
الفلك يعلو فوقك.
عائلتك تتجمع، صامتة أمام الخشب.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Pride poisons the work. You catch yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Thank God for the strength given
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 6:9 — Noah walked with God and gave Him thanks for every step.

animals.title: اثنين اثنين
animals.text:
تأتي المخلوقات من كل أرض.
أسود بجانب حملان. نسور عند قدميك.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Fear blinds you. God sent every one.
[TODO:ar] Genesis 7:8-9 — The animals came to Noah two by two, and he received them.

boarding.title: يُغلق الباب
boarding.text:
عائلتك في الداخل. الحيوانات تستقر.
الله نفسه يغلق الباب.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Run back out to warn them again
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The door is sealed. The choice has been made.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Hold your wife's hand and wait
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 7:16 — The Lord Himself shut the door of the ark behind Noah.

storm.title: تُفتح السماوات
storm.text:
يهطل المطر كشيء لم يُرَ من قبل.
تتفجر الأعماق. يغرق العالم.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The sound swallows your cry.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Trust that God is just and merciful
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 7:23 — Noah trusted God as the flood covered the earth.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Try to pull strangers from the water
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The door is sealed. There is nothing to be done.

inside.title: أربعون يومًا
inside.text:
يهتز الفلك. تتنفس الحيوانات.
تتلاشى الأيام. لا يبقى إلا صرير الخشب.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 7:24 — Noah cared for his family and the animals through 150 days on the waters.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Sit alone and let despair grow
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The silence presses on you. Faith dims.

dove.title: تعود الحمامة
dove.text:
تطلق حمامة. تمر ساعات.
تعود — ورقة زيتون في منقارها.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Even now, doubt fights to hold you.
[TODO:ar] Genesis 8:11 — The dove returned with an olive leaf — a sign of new life.

dry_land.title: الأرض تحت قدميك
dry_land.text:
يُفتح الباب. تتدفق الشمس.
تخطو على طين دافئ حي.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Rush to claim the new land
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The land was never yours to claim.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Kneel and build an altar to God
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Genesis 8:20 — Noah's first act on dry land was to build an altar to the Lord.

covenant.title: قوس قزح
covenant.text:
قوس قزح يقوس السماء.
"لن يحدث هذا مرة أخرى. هذا عهدي معك."
